subject.title: fix(ollama): bound model pull body reads past idle timeout

question: Should Ollama setup abort a continuously advancing model pull after six hours, or should the watchdog apply only while numeric download progress is absent?
rationale: Ollama’s documented progress protocol has no total-duration SLA, while a bounded status-only path is needed to stop adversarial keepalive drips; choosing the permanent compatibility boundary is maintainer product policy.

options.title: Do not cap advancing transfers
options.body: Keep the no-progress watchdog for non-advancing/status-only traffic, but remove the absolute deadline when aggregate `completed` continues to grow.

options.title: Retain a documented hard cap
options.body: Keep the six-hour limit only if maintainers intentionally accept setup failures for legitimate low-bandwidth or very-large-model downloads and document that operator impact.

recommendation.title: Do not cap advancing transfers
recommendation.body: Keep the no-progress watchdog for non-advancing/status-only traffic, but remove the absolute deadline when aggregate `completed` continues to grow.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available current-main history signal on the guarded Ollama pull path, though the timeout-policy ownership trail is incomplete.
